youAndDating.title: You & dating
youAndDating.lead: If you are looking for a lasting relationship — not a weekend distraction — you are in the right place.
youAndDating.body: Oprecht is for singles who want clarity: who you are, what you value, and what you seek in a partner. We keep the experience selective so every suggestion deserves your attention.

method.title: Our method
method.lead: A values and preferences quiz guides who we introduce — one profile at a time.
method.body: After you answer roughly 30–50 questions, we score compatibility and surface suggestions in order of fit. You Like or Pass. Mutual interest opens the door to Premium messaging. No open directory, no random browse.

safety.title: Safety
safety.lead: Trust is part of the product — not an afterthought.
safety.body: You must be 18+. Report and block tools are available once matching ships. We moderate photos and reports. Meet in public places, never share financial details, and trust your instincts. See Safety tips for practical guidance.

service.title: Service
service.lead: Human support for a Belgian product.
service.body: Questions about your account, membership or safety? Reach us via Help & contact. We aim to reply within two business days during soft launch.

prices.title: Prices
prices.lead: Start free. Upgrade when you are ready to talk.
prices.intro: Basic lets you register, complete the quiz, build a profile, and Like or Pass on blurred suggestion cards (up to 10 per day). Premium unlocks clear photos, unlimited messaging, who liked you, visitors, radius ranking and continuous suggestions.
prices.note: Payments via Mollie in a later milestone. Prices shown in EUR incl. VAT where applicable.

items.a1: Yes to start: Basic includes registration, the values quiz, profile and daily Like/Pass on blurred cards. Messaging and clear photos need Premium.
items.a2: Soft launch Flanders-first (Dutch), with French and English ready in the product.
items.a3: You complete a values quiz. We suggest one person at a time based on compatibility — not an open member search.
items.a4: Yes. We ask for your date of birth and reject under-18 registrations.
items.a5: Dutch, French and English. Switch anytime with the language control.

about.title: About Oprecht
about.body: Oprecht means honest. We build a subscription dating service for singles seeking a serious relationship in Belgium. Curated suggestions from a values quiz — not swipe fatigue.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.body: These terms govern use of Oprecht. You must be 18+, provide accurate information, and treat other members with respect. Premium renewals and cancellation details will be finalised before paid launch. content:draft — legal counsel review pending.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body: We process account, quiz and profile data to operate matching. Consent for terms and privacy is logged at registration. Marketing emails are opt-in (default off). You may request export or deletion once GDPR endpoints ship. content:draft — DPO review pending.

cookiesPage.title: Cookie policy
cookiesPage.body: Essential cookies: session and locale. Optional analytics cookies stay disabled until you consent. We do not sell personal data. content:draft

help.title: Help & contact
help.body: Email support@oprecht.example (placeholder). Soft-launch response within two business days. For urgent safety issues, use report tools when available and contact local authorities if you are in danger.

items.i1: Meet in public places for the first meetings.
items.i2: Never send money or share banking details.
items.i3: Keep personal addresses private until you trust someone.
items.i4: Use report and block if someone makes you uncomfortable.
items.i5: Tell a friend where you are going when you meet someone new.
